## New cards
* Totemic Carvings -- COST 0. If this is Generated by Totem, look at 6 6-cost monsters and choose one to give -6 cost. Add all of them to your hand. [green soul]
* Void Laser -- COST 4. Turn end: Shuffle a Gaster Blaster into your deck. ATK 1, [magenta soul], HP 8.
* G Machine -- COST 6. Taunt. Haste. Delay: If this is dead, add a Gaster Blaster to your hand with -2 cost. ATK 5, [magenta soul], HP 5.
